parameters.name: DeviceDataFlag
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to push upstream device messages. Valid values:

*   **true**: yes.
*   **false**: no.

Default value: **false**.

parameters.name: DeviceLifeCycleFlag
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to push messages about device lifecycle changes. Valid values:

*   **true**: yes.
*   **false**: no.

Default value: **false**.

parameters.name: DeviceStatusChangeFlag
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to push messages about device status changes. Valid values:

*   **true**: yes.
*   **false**: no.

Default value: **false**.

parameters.name: DeviceTagFlag
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to push messages about topological relationship changes of devices. Valid values:

*   **true**: yes. This parameter takes effect only if the **Type** parameter is set to **AMQP**.
*   **false**: no.

Default value: **false**.

parameters.name: DeviceTopoLifeCycleFlag
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to push messages about topological relationship changes of devices. Valid values:

*   **true**: yes. This parameter is valid only for gateway products.
*   **false**: no.

Default value: **false**.

parameters.name: FoundDeviceListFlag
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to push messages if a gateway detects new sub-devices. Valid values:

*   **true**: yes. This parameter is valid only for gateway products.
*   **false**: no.

Default value: **false**.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the instance. You can view the instance **ID** on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

>*   If your instance has an ID, you must configure this parameter. If you do not set this parameter, the call fails.
>*   If your instance has no **Overview** page or ID, you do not need to set this parameter.

For more information, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: MnsConfiguration
parameters.description:
The configurations of the MNS queue. This parameter is required if the **Type** parameter is set to **AMQP**.

For more information, see the "Definition of the MnsConfiguration parameter" section.

parameters.name: OtaEventFlag
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to push notifications about the status of OTA update batches. Valid values:

*   **true**: yes.
*   **false**: no.

Default value: **false**.

parameters.name: OtaJobFlag
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to push notifications about the statuses of OTA update batches. Valid values:

*   **true**: yes. This parameter takes effect only if the **Type** parameter is set to **AMQP**.
*   **false**: no.

Default value: **false**.

parameters.name: OtaVersionFlag
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to push messages about OTA module version numbers. Valid values:

*   **true**: yes. This parameter takes effect only if the **Type** parameter is set to **AMQP**.
*   **false**: no.

Default value: **false**.

parameters.name: ProductKey
parameters.description: The **ProductKey** of the product that is specified for the subscription.

parameters.name: ThingHistoryFlag
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to push upstream historical Thing Specification Language (TSL) data. Valid values:

*   **true**: yes.
*   **false**: no.

Default value: **false**.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The type of the subscription. Valid values:

*   **MNS**
*   **AMQP**

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot update-subscribe-relation --device-status-change-flag true --iot-instance-id iot-cn-0pp1n8t0000 --thing-history-flag true --product-key a1fyXVF0000 --type AMQP --device-data-flag true --device-topo-life-cycle-flag true --found-device-list-flag true --ota-event-flag true --device-life-cycle-flag true --mns-configuration queueName_:_mns-test-topic1_,_regionName_:_cn-shanghai_,_role_:_roleArn_:_acs:ram::5645000:role/aliyuniotaccessingmnsrole_,_roleName_:_AliyunIOTAccessingMNSRole --device-tag-flag true --ota-version-flag true --ota-job-flag true --subscribe-flags jt808DeviceDataFlag_:_true --consumer-group-ids example-string --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
